image_description: A Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) submerged in shallow water among green seaweed. The crab features a broad, oval carapace with reddish-brown coloration and lighter mottling. Two large claws are visible at the front, and several walking legs extend laterally, partially obscured by the aquatic vegetation.
